The experience

Celebrate connection, creativity and community with a private, hands-on charcuterie workshop hosted by Char by Riya.

Gather up to six friends, colleagues or fellow leaders for an interactive culinary experience at a venue of your choice. Whether you’re celebrating friendship or bringing inspiring women together, this experience is designed to create meaningful connections over beautiful food.

Riya will guide your group through the art of building and styling a board, sharing expert tips on flavor pairings and presentation. By the end, each guest will have created a charcuterie masterpiece of their own.

Your experience includes

Instruction
Guided, hands-on instruction in the art of charcuterie board building and styling
Ingredients
A curated selection of artisan cheeses, meats, fruits and specialty accompaniments
Supplies
All supplies, materials and tools needed for the workshop
Expert tips
Flavor pairings, presentation and how to create a stunning spread
Take-home
Each guest creates their own charcuterie board

Your host

The founder & the brand.

Founder

Riya Patel

Riya Patel founded Char by Riya in 2020. What began as a creative passion project during the pandemic, making charcuterie boards for family and friends, quickly grew into a business serving private events, celebrations, corporate gatherings, weddings, workshops and brand experiences across the New Jersey tri-state area.

Drawing on her South Asian heritage, Riya weaves unexpected flavors, ingredients and cultural influences into her creations, pairing classic charcuterie with Indian bites in a style that is familiar, surprising and welcoming to every guest.

At the heart of her work is a simple belief: food has the power to create connection, spark conversation and turn ordinary gatherings into memorable experiences.

The Brand

Char by Riya

Char by Riya creates beautifully styled charcuterie experiences that combine exceptional ingredients, artistic presentation and meaningful hospitality. As one of the first South Asian fusion charcuterie businesses in the New Jersey tri-state area, it brings a fresh perspective to grazing, from Indo-fusion boards to luxury grazing tables.

Its mission is to create unforgettable experiences through thoughtfully curated food, beautiful presentation and meaningful connection, celebrating culture, community and life’s special moments.
